note: Demo block chosen by the 2026-11-14 scout (docs/demo-candidates.md on lane-a/scout). Until out/listings/index.json exists, this file maps listing ids to Matterport models. interior_source: 'panorama' (default) = clean shell + scan pieces textured from the original panoramas; 'matterpak' = raw textured scan; 'defurnished' = flat-colour defurnished mesh (needs interior_mesh).
live_pack_version_note: The one pack version everything uses (publish, audit, costar, the agent). Change it only with `python -m worldgen.versions pin`, never by hand; builders refuse to write into it.

pack_history.reason: adds the combined block (procedural near zone with ortho-fitted roads, curbs, sidewalks, driveways and walks; Vexcel 3D Cities far zone), sidewalk spawns, hero listed first, furniture v2 (adds 3 TVs); houses copied unchanged from v1

streets_note: Street centrelines [lat, lon] from OpenStreetMap (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors), ways 20877931 and 15446976 (Navidad Road) and 20908319 and 15308404 (Bellaire Boulevard, its southern carriageway), fetched 2026-11-14. worldgen.costar uses them to pick the street-facing front door of each house.
